correctness.rationale: The first critical values of Q_2 and Q_3 are obtained from exact low-degree Jacobi formulas. Their amplitude ratio is transformed to an explicit R(t). The inequality log B>2(B-1)/(B+1) reduces the logarithmic derivative to a rational lower bound whose controlling polynomial is strictly increasing but remains negative on q in (1,sqrt(3)); hence R is strictly increasing. Its left limit is 1/2, while the source theorem gives R(-1/3)>1, proving a unique threshold and the complete sign trichotomy. The critical-point position inequality follows from a separate exact positive polynomial identity.
